y-m-68-06.material:
Ɗalibai biyu sun samo derivative na f(x)=xˣ (x>0).
Ɗalibi A: “Exponent x ne, saboda haka a (xⁿ)′=n·x⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾ saka x a matsayin n, sai f′(x)=x·x⁽ˣ⁻¹⁾=xˣ.”
Ɗalibi B: “Ɗaukar ln a ɓangarorin biyu yana ba ln f=x·ln x; derivative kuma f′/f=ln x+1, don haka f′(x)=xˣ(ln x+1).”
Don tantance daidai, an samu matsakaicin canji a x=1, (f(1.001)−f(1))/0.001, da kalkuleta, kusan 1.0010. (1, 1)

y-m-68-08.title: Ga ƙaramin ɗalibi da ya ce derivative na sin 3x shi ne cos 3x
y-m-68-08.topic: Hanyoyin differentiation: bayyana wa ƙarami derivative na aiki mai expression a ciki
y-m-68-08.goal: Ka mutunta kuskuren ƙaramin ɗalibi da ya koyi Calculus I kawai, rubuta bayani mai gwajin da zai iya yi da kansa da dalilin amsar ba daidai ba. (3)
y-m-68-08.material: Ƙaramin ɗalibi da ya koyi derivative na polynomial da sin x kawai ya rubuta y=sin 3x: “(sin x)′=cos x, don haka (sin 3x)′=cos 3x.” Ya ɗauka 3x rukuni ɗaya ne kamar x. Ana buƙatar hanyar gwada da kansa. (Sine na 3x da cosine na 3x.)
y-m-68-08.thinking.2: Daidaita bayani da abin da mai sauraro, ƙaramin ɗalibi, bai sani ba

y-m-68-08.s.s1.hint.0: Idan amsar cos 3x daidai ce, wace gangara ce dole a samu a x=0?
y-m-68-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, tantance ko ƙaramin ɗalibi zai iya gwada shi da kansa kuma ko gwajin zai nuna amsar ba daidai ba ce.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.o.a: Ka sa ya sake karanta (sin x)′=cos x a littafin, ya tabbatar ana iya amfani da 3x kamar x.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.r.a: Sake karanta ƙa’ida ba ya tabbatar da cewa 3x yana da rawar iri ɗaya da x. Babu hanyar gwada amsar.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.o.b: Nuna sin 3x=3 sin x sannan ka sa ya fito a gaba. (3)
y-m-68-08.s.s1.r.b: sin 3x=3 sin x ba daidai ba ne. Misali, idan x=π/6, sin(π/2)=1 amma 3 sin(π/6)=1.5.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.o.c: Ka sa ya lissafta (sin 3h−sin 0)/h ga ƙaramin h kusa da x=0, sannan ya kwatanta da cos 0=1.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ya sa ya gwada amsar da ƙimar da zai iya lissafa da kansa.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.o.d: Bayyana cewa y=sin 3x ma siffar sinus ce, saboda haka gangararsa iri ɗaya ce da y=sin x.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.r.d: Ko siffar sinus ce, matse ta a kwance yana sa ta fi tudu. Siffa iri ɗaya ba ta tabbatar da gangara iri ɗaya ba.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.o.e: Ka sa ya tuna cewa jadawalin sin 3x jadawalin sin x ne da aka matse a kwance zuwa sulusin faɗi, sannan ya yi tunanin canjin gangara.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.r.e: Wannan ya sa ya samo dalilin canjin gangara daga canjin siffar jadawali.
y-m-68-08.s.s1.explain: Idan h=0.01, sin(0.03)/0.01≈2.9996, saboda haka gangara a x=0 kusan 3 ce, ba cos 0=1 ba. Matse jadawali a kwance zuwa sulusinsa yana sa irin canjin tsayi ya faru sau 3 da sauri, don haka gangara ma ta ninku sau 3. Ƙaramin ɗalibi zai iya gwada hanyoyin biyun. Sake karanta ƙa’ida ko cewa siffa iri ɗaya ce ba zai gano kuskuren ba.

y-m-68-04.title: Lanƙwasa da ta ratsa asalin sau biyu: shin layin tangent guda ɗaya ne kawai?
y-m-68-04.topic: Hanyoyin asalawa iri-iri: layukan tangent ga lanƙwasa da aka bayyana ta parameter (wuri ɗaya, layukan tangent dabam)
y-m-68-04.goal: Koyi cewa haɗin gwiwar wuri kaɗai ba za su kayyade layin tangent guda na lanƙwasa da aka bayar ta parameter ba, ƙirƙiri ƙimomin parameter da dama da suka cika sharadi, sannan ka faɗi ƙarin abin da ya kamata a sani.
y-m-68-04.material: An bayyana lanƙwasa C ta x=t²−9, y=(t³−9t)/3 ga lambar ainihi t. Yayin da t ke sauyawa, wurin (x,y) yana tafiya bisa lanƙwasa. Misali, idan t=0, wurin (−9, 0) ne. t=3 da t=−3 duka suna ratsa asalin (0, 0). Yayin da t ke tafiya daga −3 zuwa 3, wurin yana barin asali, yana kewaya madauwari a gefen hagu inda x≤0, sannan ya dawo asali. Saboda haka lanƙwasa tana haɗuwa da kanta a asali. Gangarar tangent tana dogara da alkiblar da wurin yake motsawa a t (amma ana iya magana kan gangara ne kawai a wuraren da x ke sauyawa tare da t).

y-m-68-04.thinking.2: Gwada faɗaɗa iƙirari da misalin ƙaryatawa (wuri iri ɗaya, layukan tangent dabam).

y-m-68-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi bayanin da ya fi dacewa game da gangarar layin tangent na lanƙwasa C a asali.

y-m-68-04.s.s1.o.a: Asali wurin x=0 ne, saboda haka t=0; a lokacin saurin sauyin x 0 ne, don haka ba za a tantance gangarar tangent ba.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.r.a: Ƙimomin t da x=0 ke ba su sun fito daga t²=9, don haka t=3 ko t=−3. t=0 yana ba da wurin (−9, 0), ba asali ba.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.o.b: Ana ratsa asali sau biyu, a t=3 da t=−3, kuma gangara tana bambanta a kowane lokaci, saboda haka haɗin gwiwar wurin kaɗai ba za su ba da gangara guda ba.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.r.b: Ka bambanta ƙimar t da lanƙwasa ke ratsa wuri iri ɗaya, sannan ka duba dabam layukan tangent a wurin da aka ratsa sau biyu.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.o.c: Ana ratsa asali a t=3, saboda haka gangara guda ce tabbatacciya. t=−3 kawai yana ƙirga wannan wuri sau ɗaya.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.r.c: Alkiblar da lanƙwasa ke ratsa asali a t=−3 ta bambanta da ta t=3. Ko a wuri guda, idan alkiblar ratsawa ta bambanta, layin tangent na iya bambanta.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.o.d: Asali wuri ne da y=0 kuma lanƙwasa ta tsallaka layin x, saboda haka gangarar tangent 0 ce.
y-m-68-04.s.s1.r.d: Lanƙwasa ta haɗu da layin x ba yana nufin layin tangent yana layi ɗaya da x ba. Dole ne a duba dabam alkiblar motsi a wurin.
